Bold comic-book ink style, heavy linework, red and blue-black palette, night city. Use <Picture 2> and <Picture 1> as reference frames and <Audio 1> exactly as it is.
CUT 1: top-down view of the little boy superhero on the rooftop — red cape fluttering in the wind, hands planted on his hips, freckles and a cocky grin as he looks straight up into the camera. The camera slowly descends toward him as he delivers his line — as he speaks, comic-book graphic overlay text word by word in sync with his voice: "GET READY TO" - "MEET" — "YOUR" — "MAKER" — huge jagged comic lettering, white with heavy black outlines and red drop shadows, tilted at scrappy angles, until the three words hang stacked in the air above him between his face and the lens.
TRANSITION: a violent WHIP PAN off the rooftop that SMEARS the floating words away with it, motion-streaked —
CUT 2: low hero angle on the colossal black mech-kaiju towering over the skyline as it rears back and unleashes a GIANT terrifying ROAR — jaws wide with fangs, red eyes and chest-core flaring blinding bright, blue lightning arcing off its head, the roar's shockwave rippling dust and rattling windows down the buildings, comic-style speed-lines and ink splatter bursting from the impact of the sound. It leans INTO the camera as the roar peaks. Hold on the roar.

[场景与光影]: 阳光明媚、色彩斑斓的花丛盛开着繁茂的玫瑰、野花与熏衣草 。黄金时期的阳光穿透花丛，形成温暖的体积光、柔和的轮廓光以及在微风中飘浮的闪烁光斑 。
[主体细节]: S1 是一名极具吸引力的 24岁美丽东亚女性，一头长长的自然黑发上沾着微小花瓣，面部轮廓精致，肌肤透着温暖的光泽 。她穿着一条浅色复古花卉雪纺连衣裙，随风轻轻飘动 。
[镜头与运镜]:  [00:00-00:04]: 电影级中景镜头，24帧 。镜头围绕 S1 缓慢平稳地环绕轨道移动，前景伴有虚化的花朵，形成梦幻的浅景深 。  [00:04-00:08]: 镜头顺滑推进，更加靠近 S1 灿烂的表情，背景花丛呈现出极具质感的光斑虚化 。
[动作与动态]:  [00:00-00:04]: S1 优雅地站在高耸的花丛中，指尖轻柔地抚摸一片花瓣，微风吹拂着她的裙摆与发丝 。  [00:04-00:08]: S1 缓缓转头看向镜头，露出宁静而柔和的明媚笑容，发丝在风中微微飘动 。
[音画同步]:  音效 (SFX): 微风吹过花草的沙沙声、远处清脆的鸟鸣声以及静谧的自然环境音 。  背景音乐 (BGM): 温暖舒缓的原声吉他与钢琴弦乐乐曲，营造出梦幻而浪漫的氛围

Realistic live-action cinematic look, action movie trailer: practical film photography style, a post-rain dusk metropolis, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, film grain, city volumetric fog, flying-car traffic between the towers, restrained grading for a premium feel, powerful natural movement.
Scene overview: at dusk on a cluster of skyscrapers, a stunning Asian beauty (elegant East-Asian features, long dark hair whipping in the wind, athletic yet feminine figure) is being chased, sprinting and leaping across rooftops, jumping from one building’s roof to the next with pursuers closing in behind. This is the escape sequence of an action movie trailer: every leap is life-or-death, thrilling and fluid.
Storyboard (each shot a separate scene, rapid cuts, all landing on the musical beats):
[0s-1.5s] Shot 1: high side angle: the Asian beauty sprinting at the roof edge, pursuers appearing in the rooftop doorway behind her, wind catching her long coat.
[1s-2.5s] Shot 2: she leaps across the gap between buildings, body stretching mid-air in a powerful yet graceful arc, towers and flying-car light trails behind her, a slight slow-motion feel.
[2.5s-4s] Shot 3: she lands, rolls and rises, low-angle shot, tower shadows and fog behind her, she keeps running.
[4s-5s] Shot 4: freeze: the instant she hits the edge of the next roof and launches into the jump, silhouette of her athletic female form, holding.
Camera: each shot its own angle, cuts clean and hard, no dissolves, a slight frame jitter on the jumps.
Audio: wind, rapid footsteps, city ambience, low score underneath, an accent hit on each leap, the score bursting at 4s, closing the last 1s.
No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks of any kind, no animation or cartoon rendering, no overly-CG look, keep the live-action texture.

网友@绯命实测本地实测文本编码器int8的版本对提示词遵循度要强于nvfp4，int8的速度反而没有比nvfp4慢太多，所以有条件的话还是上in8吧。

文本编码器模型只在最开始分析提示词的时候会使用到，之后就从显存卸载了，对性能影响非常小。
内存够的情况，选择更大的模型吧，因为会对你提示词理解有很大加成。

Video 1 作为表情演技参考，严格沿用其表情变化的时序、肌肉细节动作与情绪递进节奏；Image 1 作为角色参考，全程保留人物的黑色碎发发型、清秀五官样貌与白色衬衫，人物身份不发生偏移。
整体风格与契约：真人实拍，电影级写实质感，自然漫射日光，写实细腻的真实皮肤纹理与毛孔细节，浅景深背景虚化。
分镜时间线：
[0s-1s]：角色面向镜头，保持中性平静的表情，眼神平稳凝视前方，嘴角放松。
[1s-2s]：表情开始变化，眼睛张大，眉毛微微向上扬起，露出惊讶的神态，轻微吸气。
[2s-3s]：惊讶迅速转变为惊喜与开怀，嘴角向两侧张开露出牙齿，眉眼弯曲，眼神中迸发出愉悦光芒。
[3s-5s]：开怀大笑，右手顺势抬起轻遮嘴唇，肩部随笑声微微颤动，随后手部轻轻放下，笑容自然收尾。
相机：固定机位，胸部以上特写画幅，平视角度，50mm 焦距，无推拉摇移，镜头焦点始终锁定在人物面部。
音频设计：先出现一声轻柔的惊讶吸气声，随后过渡为清亮愉悦的年轻男性开朗笑声；背景混入微弱的室内自然混响与远端风声。
约束与否定：角色五官与身份全程高度一致无畸变；表情过渡自然流畅不僵硬；无多余字幕、水印、装饰元素或画质抖动。
